# Cinelogic

> Cinelogic is an AI-assisted filmmaking and creative studio. It produces work from concept and script through direction, production, editing, sound and final delivery.

## Main pages
- [Arabic home](https://cinelogic.net/)
- [English home](https://cinelogic.net/en/)
